title: An indented comment before an end marker goes with the last entry when it is removed
notes: As for the same input at the end of the stream: a comment indented more than the key of the last entry belongs to it, and the end marker `...` stays. The comment is inside the document, before its end marker. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend wrote `{}` and the pure backend left the comment behind.
